description: This file defines location types, constants, and utility functions for managing event locations within a booking or scheduling application. It includes location type definitions, default locations, functions for retrieving and filtering locations, and localization support.

methods.name: getLocationFromApp
methods.description: Finds a location object from app store metadata based on location type.

methods.name: getEventLocationType
methods.description: Retrieves a location object by its type from the combined locations list.

methods.name: guessEventLocationType
methods.description: Guesses the event location type based on a string value or URL.

methods.name: getAppSlugFromLocationType
methods.description: Returns the app slug associated with a given location type.

methods.name: privacyFilteredLocations
methods.description: Filters locations based on privacy settings, hiding sensitive info if not public.

methods.name: getMessageForOrganizer
methods.description: Returns a localized message for the organizer based on location type.

methods.name: getHumanReadableLocationValue
methods.description: Converts a location link or type into a human-readable string.

methods.name: locationKeyToString
methods.description: Converts a LocationObject to a string based on its type and default value variable.

methods.name: getEventLocationWithType
methods.description: Finds a location object by its type from a list of locations.

methods.name: getLocationValueForDB
methods.description: Converts a location type or value into a stored database value, handling dynamic links.

methods.name: getEventLocationValue
methods.description: Retrieves the display value for a location, considering privacy and type.

methods.name: getSuccessPageLocationMessage
methods.description: Generates a message for the success page based on location and booking status.

methods.name: getTranslatedLocation
methods.description: Translates a location object into a localized string.

methods.name: getOrganizerInputLocationTypes
methods.description: Returns location types that require organizer input.

methods.name: isAttendeeInputRequired
methods.description: Checks if attendee input is required for a given location type.

methods.name: locationsResolver
methods.description: Defines a Zod schema for validating an array of location objects.
